name: fast-open-cmp
description: Consent Management Platform (CMP) compliant with IAB TCF 2.3, Google Consent Mode v2 and Additional Consent — WordPress plugin. Three working modes: full (TCF + Consent Mode), Google Consent Mode v2 only, and basic.

scripts.build: cd sdk && npm run build && cp dist/src/index.js ../plugin/assets/js/cmp-sdk.js
scripts.e2e:seed: docker compose exec -T db mariadb -uroot -proot wordpress < e2e/seed.sql

author: Lucas Web Art <https://lucaswebart.pl>
